# spheres_for_positions { #mofography.visualize.spheres_for_positions }

```python
visualize.spheres_for_positions(
    positions,
    radii=None,
    scale=0.8,
    color=[[255, 255, 255, 1]],
    theta_resolution=20,
    phi_resolution=20,
)
```

Return trimesh spheres at arbitrary positions with given radii and colors.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type   | Description                                                                                                  | Default                |
|------------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------|
| positions        |        | list of lists of floats, the positions of the atoms                                                          | _required_             |
| radii            |        | list of floats, default None                                                                                 | `None`                 |
| scale            |        | the size of the spheres                                                                                      | `0.8`                  |
| color            |        | a list of colors for each atom. If you want all atoms to be the same color, just put the one color in a list | `[[255, 255, 255, 1]]` |
| theta_resolution |        | The number of points around the polar angle, defaults to 20 (optional)                                       | `20`                   |
| phi_resolution   |        | The number of points around the azimuthal angle, defaults to 20 (optional)                                   | `20`                   |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                |
|--------|--------|----------------------------|
|        |        | A list of trimesh objects. |
